name: Yeonghonui Serenade
source:
Korea—a nation celebrated as a cultural powerhouse, yet harboring a heavy burden as the country with the highest suicide rate. The Han River, with its beautiful night views, ironically becomes a place of the most sorrowful choices for some.

At the very moment when one man chooses to let go of everything, a story begins—a story as gentle and calm as the midnight air.
